Subject: Initial question: preferred invoice path (portal vs email)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist — quick question from our finance team: for Redwood, are we expected to submit invoices through your portal exclusively, or is there still a supported "email fallback" route for the first 30 days?

Our ERP outputs a compact XLSX that includes multiple line items per PO; I attached a sample template (nimble_invoice_template_v2.xlsx). If email is acceptable as a temporary path, can you confirm the required subject token and minimum fields you need to match to a PO?

Cheers,
Jordan Ellis

NimbleWorks Ltd

Subject: Re: Initial question: preferred invoice path (portal vs email)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks — received the sample. Short answer: we prefer portal-first for production go-lives because it provides automated PO matching, richer ACKs, and line-item parsing. That said, we support a limited email handshake for legacy vendors during onboarding windows. A couple of operational constraints: 

- Portal is preferred for recurring suppliers or where POs are used regularly.
- Email fallback is allowed for up to 30 days post-activation and must include a subject token in the format: INVOICE|{PO_NUMBER}|{VENDOR_ID}
- Minimum fields in the email body or XLSX: Redwood PO number, invoice date, invoice total, currency, and at least one line item row with unit price + quantity.

If you want, we can enable the email fallback for NimbleWorks while we finish portal provisioning. Marissa, can you confirm the activation ETA if Jordan opts for portal? Karthik, adding you since you own the NimbleWorks commercial touchpoints.

Best,
Irene Choi
Procurement Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Hi Jordan — quick note from finance/ops side: we can fast-track portal access for NimbleWorks within 5 business days provided your portal admin completes the vendor intake form (link below) and we receive a signed W-9 (US) / tax doc. For the email handshake:

- We'll accept emails to invoices@redwoodinference.com with subject starting INVOICE|{PO}|{VENDOR_ID}.
- CSV/XLSX attachments are fine; prefer the compact layout you sent. Please make sure the file has a PO column named exactly "PO_Number" (case-sensitive) and line items include "Line_Description", "Qty", "Unit_Price".
- If multiple POs are bundled in one file, each row must include the PO_Number. Our parser will create separate invoice records for each PO.

If you want to proceed with email fallback while portal is set up, confirm the vendor_id you want us to map (we'll use NIMBLE-001 by default). Also attaching the vendor intake link and a minimal sample CSV we prefer.

Marissa Cole
Director, AP Operations
Redwood Inference
[Vendor intake form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3-example-invoice-templates]
